name: default-workflows
description: Default fkst session bundle: the development (workflow-dev), security-review (workflow-security), and workflow-authoring (workflow-writer) adapters plus their package dependencies, resolved so a trigger need only reference this manifest. Each adapter auto-declares its own work label via [github].work_labels (fkst-dev / fkst-security / fkst-workflow), so a session using this manifest can omit ### Work Label and be driven by all three. It also bundles fkst-health, which writes a session health report every ten minutes for the dashboard to render; fkst-health declares NO work label, so its presence leaves every session's effective work-label set unchanged.
